profile.reading:
This row, named "QTS Ashburn 2," sits roughly 700 meters from this registry's three QTS Ashburn Lockridge entries. QTS's own current locations page lists "Ashburn 1, Ashburn 2, Ashburn 3, and Ashburn Moran" as four separate named Sterling/Ashburn, VA facilities, but without street addresses for each. The only two aggregator listings found for the exact name "Ashburn 2" (a DataCenterMap page and an UPSTACK listing) both redirect to or reuse "Lockridge DC2" branding, and the UPSTACK page itself returned a 404 error on a fresh fetch; this leaves genuine uncertainty over whether "Ashburn 2" names a facility distinct from the already-addressed Lockridge campus, or is simply an alternate aggregator label for Lockridge's second building. Because this row's own mapped coordinates sit several hundred meters from the Lockridge cluster, this registry does not apply the Lockridge address here, and no other independently confirmed address was found this session. Rather than guess, this row states the ambiguity plainly: it is documented as a QTS-attributed Sterling/Ashburn-area facility whose specific building identity and street address remain unresolved, an honest short entry rather than a fabricated match.

QTS was founded in 2003 in Overland Park, Kansas, and was taken private in a roughly $10 billion Blackstone acquisition completed August 31, 2021. QTS's confirmed Northern Virginia footprint in this registry (Ashburn 1/Ashburn-Shellhorn/Ashburn Lockridge/Ashburn-Moran, all in Sterling/Ashburn, Loudoun County) is extensive enough that a fourth or fifth named "Ashburn"-branded building being real, just not yet independently address-confirmed, is entirely plausible rather than a mapping error; a future researcher with Loudoun County parcel records could likely resolve this.

reading.body:
QTS Ashburn 2 is a 75 MW campus spanning two buildings on 24 acres in Sterling, Loudoun County, Virginia, though its specific street address remains unresolved despite research effort; QTS's own site names the facility but does not publish individual building addresses, and the only aggregator matches redirect to other QTS Ashburn-area names. At typical AI training densities of 40 kW per rack, this would represent roughly 1,875 racks assuming full IT load utilization, though the campus's actual configuration and tenant mix are not published.

Virginia publishes 1,375 MW of data center capacity across 23 facilities statewide. Ashburn 2 ranks 24th in Virginia by announced capacity, just below the published threshold, and sits in Loudoun County's dense Ashburn cluster where QTS operates at least three other named facilities within a few hundred meters. The state context itself indicates that most of Virginia's 330 mapped facilities do not publish power figures, so this campus's announcement places it in a small disclosed tier.

The campus holds no published certifications or qualification statements beyond its operator's naming. No building square footage, cooling type, power infrastructure detail, or tenant information is published in the specifications provided.
